# W3C RDB2RDF test cases (R2RML and Direct Mapping): provenance

Vendored into `third_party/testing/rdb2rdf-tests/` on 2026-11-01 for
https://github.com/danbri/factoidal/issues/1165 (spec track A, R2RML and the
Direct Mapping).

- Index: "R2RML and Direct Mapping Test Cases", W3C Editor's Draft 24 July
  2012 (`$Date: 2012/07/24 16:16:39 $`), https://www.w3.org/2001/sw/rdb2rdf/test-cases/,
  saved as `index.html` (sha256
  `506731f3ccc1b69cc9044c743e211ca0fd191e1279de230aa7c6cab171f2d5bf`).
  Editors: Boris Villazón-Terrazas, Michael Hausenblas.
- Files: every file that the index links under
  `https://dvcs.w3.org/hg/rdb2rdf-tests/raw-file/default/` (189 files in 26
  database directories `D000` to `D025`), retrieved 2026-11-01 with `curl -f`.
  The Mercurial archive (`/archive/tip.tar.gz`) answers HTTP 410, so no
  changeset id is available; the sha256 of each file is below.
- Content: 26 databases (`create.sql`), 24 Direct Mapping cases
  (`directGraph.ttl`) and 63 R2RML cases (`r2rml*.ttl`, `mapped*.nq`; 14 of
  them have `rdb2rdftest:hasExpectedOutput false`, that is, the mapping must be
  rejected). The manifests are `D*/manifest.ttl`; there is no top-level manifest.
- Licence: Copyright © 2012 W3C (MIT, ERCIM, Keio). W3C test suite licence
  (https://www.w3.org/copyright/test-suites-licence/), which permits use and
  redistribution under the W3C 3-clause BSD License.
- Specifications under test: R2RML: RDB to RDF Mapping Language, W3C
  Recommendation 27 September 2012 (https://www.w3.org/TR/2012/REC-r2rml-20120927/);
  A Direct Mapping of Relational Data to RDF, W3C Recommendation 27 September
  2012 (https://www.w3.org/TR/2012/REC-rdb-direct-mapping-20120927/).
